collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A heron on the far bank of the stream has been staring at a villager, not at the fish, for some time.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) is washing (his/her) clothes at the stream when (he/she) notices a heron standing on the opposite bank, staring at (him/her). Not at the water. Not at the fish. At (name1). It has been staring, without blinking, for some time. (name1) is starting to feel self-conscious.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) stops washing and stares back. The heron doesn't move. Neither does (name1). This goes on for a very long time. Finally the heron blinks first, slowly, and turns its back, as if it has seen everything it needs to see. (name1) has no idea whether (he/she) passed or failed.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) keeps washing. The heron keeps staring. When (name1) has finished and picks up (his/her) basket, the heron, very deliberately, steps into the water exactly where (name1) was standing, and catches a fish that (name1) must have been scaring away all morning. (name1) decides to take that personally.
